replitClassification.explanation: PrimeOpp's ONLY current host is Replit's own .replit autoscale config (fact, per PRIMEOPP_DOMAIN_READINESS.md and PrimeOS's own ecosystem-hosting-target-map.md). That is historical/dev-stack provenance, not a deployment recommendation — Replit is never an approved production/staging target in this system. PrimeOS's ecosystem-hosting-target-map.md separately recommends Railway once a target is actually selected; this fixture makes no assumption about which approved host will be chosen and does not name Replit as a provider anywhere in this contract (providerType is generic_env, never replit — replit is not, and will never be, a value in lib/provider-actions/types.ts's PROVIDER_TYPES enum).
